scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.build:web: pnpm --filter @workspace/luminae run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.android:sync: node scripts/validate-release-environment.mjs android && pnpm --filter @workspace/luminae run native:sync
scripts.android:play:bundle: pnpm run android:sync && artifacts/luminae/android/gradlew -p artifacts/luminae/android bundlePlayRelease
scripts.android:galaxy:bundle: pnpm run android:sync && artifacts/luminae/android/gradlew -p artifacts/luminae/android bundleGalaxyRelease
scripts.release:verify:static: pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server test && pnpm --filter @workspace/luminae test && pnpm run build:web && pnpm run verify:blueprint-secrecy
scripts.lint:version-stamps: pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run test:version-stamps && pnpm --filter @workspace/scripts run lint:version-stamps
scripts.verify:coordination: pnpm --filter @workspace/luminae run verify:coordination && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run verify:coordination
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run normalize:affinities && pnpm run lint:terminology && pnpm run lint:version-stamps && pnpm run lint:summon-colors && pnpm run lint:luminary-files && pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
